facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold, three-quarters price for their barrow treasure, once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the party still holds the note or handed it over to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.

facts.text: The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment out of Cedric's promissory note for joining the party against the dragon. Their share and the payment terms were not stated.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated how much of the note goes to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda or when they are paid.
